info.title: llama-skein control API
info.description:
## Failure status codes

A caller can distinguish failure classes by status code alone, without parsing prose:

| code | meaning | raised by |
|------|---------|-----------|
| 429 | Concurrency limit reached; retry shortly. | router session-cap / HTTP concurrency middleware |
| 502 | Model process started but failed warm-up; never became ready. | load failure |
| 503 | Queued behind a busy sibling past `swapQueueTimeoutSecs`. | swap queue |
| 507 | Loading would exceed host memory; the load was refused before launching. | fit guard |
| 500 | Unclassified internal error. | residual |

Readiness is pollable at `GET /health` before dispatching, which is cheaper than
discovering the state by issuing an inference request.

get.summary: Returns the configured default model used when a request omits the 'model' field.

200.description: Default model info. 'model' is null when no default is configured.

get.summary: Returns the current persistent user profile for GPU power and silent-mode preferences.

200.description: Current user profile with active state.

503.description: GPU power control not available on this host.

get.summary: Returns a default profile template for the host.
Fit report for every configured model on this host: fit level, max-safe context, throughput estimate. The per-host payload skein aggregates for fleet placement.
Fit of one model to this host. Optional ctx query scores a specific context size instead of computing the max-safe one.

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: Score this context size instead of computing max_safe_ctx.

post.summary: Fit of a model that is NOT on disk: a gallery/catalog candidate scored before download. Takes a descriptor (explicit dims when the catalog knows them, else a parameter count to estimate from) plus one or more quant variants with file sizes; returns per-variant verdicts in the same vocabulary as /api/fit plus the recommended variant. Skein's fleet gallery calls this on every host to build its model-x-host-x-quant matrix.

400.description: Malformed descriptor: no variants, a variant without name or file_bytes, or an unsupported backend.

get.summary: Effective GPU tuning for this host (detected arch, enabled state, resolved profile, provenance).

patch.summary: Override or disable the recommended tuning for this host (persisted; applied on next model reload).

get.summary: The full tuning database (all gfx x use-case profiles) for client pickers.

get.description: Reports per-model state and last_error plus provider-level residency and busyness. Previously a bare 200 "OK", which could not distinguish a healthy host from one whose model had failed to load.
Every local process that is not stopped or shut down, joined against its config.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Pass 'running' to list only loaded models.

post.summary: Dry-run validate a config without applying it.
post.description: Validates the on-disk config file, or the YAML in the request body when provided. Never writes anything and never triggers a reload — use POST /api/config/reload to actually apply a change.

200.description: Validation result (valid may be true or false — this endpoint always returns 200; check the body).

get.summary: List retained config snapshots, newest first.

post.summary: Restore the config to a previous snapshot and reload.
post.description: The config active immediately before the rollback is itself snapshotted first — a rollback is a change like any other and can itself be undone.

post.summary: Submit an install plan; creates a ModelOperation.
post.description: Validates and snapshots the plan (design.md decision 2) before creating the operation. Returns immediately with the operation at phase "queued" — the caller polls GET /api/models/operations/{id} or watches the event stream for progress, and can disconnect/reconnect at any point without losing the operation.

400.description: Invalid plan: untrusted source, malformed artifact set, or an already-configured model_id.

get.description: Supports reconnect and diagnostics after a client or process restart — every operation the host still has a record of, not only ones the current connection created.

post.description: Idempotent: cancelling an already-cancelled or already-terminal operation returns its current snapshot rather than an error. Partial artifacts are retained for later resume unless the operation record's retention policy says otherwise — cancellation itself never deletes them.

202.description: Cancellation requested; the operation transitions to "cancelled" asynchronously.

get.summary: Stream operation updates as they happen.
get.description: Server-sent events; each event's data is one ModelOperation snapshot, same vocabulary as GET /api/models/operations/{id}. Supplementary to the snapshot endpoint, not a replacement for it — a client that reconnects after missing events GETs the snapshot to resynchronize rather than trying to replay the stream.

200.description: Event stream open. Each event's data is a ModelOperation.

venvDir.description: Directory for the Python venv (required for mlx and vllm). For llamacpp, target directory for the binary.

InferenceInfo.description: Live inference load: in-flight model-dispatched requests vs. serving slots. The exact busy signal for schedulers — GPU utilization is sampled over a window and reads low between tokens; this does not.

in_flight.description: Model-dispatched HTTP requests currently being served, including any queued behind a model load or a busy slot.

slots_total.description: Total serving slots across running models (--parallel/-np per model command, default 1 each). 0 when no model is running.

busy.description: True when every slot of every running model is occupied (in_flight >= slots_total > 0) — a new request would queue. False when no model is running: the host is idle, it just needs a swap-in.

id.description: Model ID as defined in config. With several models loaded, the one with the largest weights is reported (ties: smallest ID) — selection is deterministic across calls.

model_mb.description: Model weight file size in MB (disk proxy for VRAM used by weights).

kv_estimate_mb.description: Estimated KV cache MB. On GPU hosts: max(0, vram.used_mb - model_mb). When that yields 0 (CPU-only inference, no GPU telemetry), falls back to the fit engine's GGUF-derived KV size at the model's usable context.

state.description: Current process state. 'failed' means the last start or load attempt failed and is distinct from 'stopped', which means idle with nothing wrong; reporting a failed load as stopped makes a broken model indistinguishable from one that was never requested.

size_bytes.description: On-disk size of the model weights in bytes: the GGUF file size for llama.cpp, or the summed safetensors size for MLX. Lets clients show a human-readable size (e.g. GB) when picking between similar quantizations. Omitted when the size can't be determined (peer models, un-resolvable path).

n_cpu_moe.description: Current --n-cpu-moe value parsed from the model command, when set (llama.cpp MoE expert CPU offload).

cpu_moe.description: True when --cpu-moe is present in the model command (all MoE experts offloaded to CPU).

cpu_offload_gb.description: Current --cpu-offload-gb value parsed from the model command, when set (vLLM weight offload).

override_tensor.description: Current --override-tensor value parsed from the model command, when set (llama.cpp tensor placement).

default.description: True when this model is the configured default, used for requests that omit the 'model' field. Listed first in the model list. llama-skein extension to the OpenAI schema.

metadata.description: Optional capability metadata for this model. llama-skein extension for MTP and other runtime capabilities.

reasoning.description: True if the model emits reasoning/thinking output (reasoning_content) before its answer. Resolved from the model config; omitted when not declared. Clients use it to enable reasoning-stream rendering.

installed.description: Whether the model's primary weights file currently exists on disk. Distinct from being configured (present in this list at all) — a configured model's weight file can be missing (deleted, moved, or never finished installing). Omitted when it cannot be determined (e.g. no -m/--model path in the command).

source_repository.description: e.g. "unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF". Recovered from the most recent succeeded install operation that registered this model_id (internal/operation.Store), not stored on the model config itself. Omitted when unknown — a model configured by hand, pulled via the older POST /api/models/pull route, or whose founding operation record has since been pruned has no recoverable source.

source_revision.description: Immutable revision (commit SHA) of source_repository, same provenance source and same omission conditions.

artifact_paths.description: Repository-relative paths of every artifact the founding install operation submitted (weights, shards, auxiliaries) — not live-rescanned from disk, so it reflects what was installed, not necessarily every file currently present at the destination. Same provenance source and omission conditions as source_repository.

active_operation_id.description: ID of a currently non-terminal model operation (see ModelOperation) whose registration.model_id is this model, if one is in progress — a reinstall, for instance. Omitted when no such operation exists.

default_model.description: Configured default model ID; omitted when no default is set.

backend.description: Inference backend type. Controls backend-specific behaviours (e.g. slot cancellation is llamacpp-only). mlx targets Apple Silicon; vllm targets NVIDIA (CUDA); AMD ROCm requires building vllm from source. Default: llamacpp.

n_cpu_moe.description: Number of leading layers whose MoE expert tensors are offloaded to CPU/RAM (llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe). llamacpp only.

cpu_moe.description: Offload ALL MoE expert tensors to CPU/RAM (llama.cpp --cpu-moe). llamacpp only.

cpu_offload_gb.description: GiB of weights to offload to CPU per GPU (vLLM --cpu-offload-gb). vllm only.

override_tensor.description: Advanced tensor placement override regex (llama.cpp --override-tensor). llamacpp only.

backend.description: Inference backend type. Controls backend-specific behaviours (e.g. slot cancellation is llamacpp-only). mlx targets Apple Silicon; vllm targets NVIDIA (CUDA); AMD ROCm requires building vllm from source. Default: llamacpp.

n_cpu_moe.description: Number of leading layers whose MoE expert tensors are offloaded to CPU/RAM (llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe). 0 removes the flag. llamacpp only.

cpu_moe.description: Offload ALL MoE expert tensors to CPU/RAM (llama.cpp --cpu-moe). false removes the flag. llamacpp only.

cpu_offload_gb.description: GiB of weights to offload to CPU per GPU (vLLM --cpu-offload-gb). 0 removes the flag. vllm only.

override_tensor.description: Advanced tensor placement override regex (llama.cpp --override-tensor). Empty removes the flag. llamacpp only.

metadata.description: Optional capability metadata for this model. llama-skein extension for MTP and other runtime capabilities.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings produced while applying the request, e.g. offload knobs unsupported by the model's backend. Omitted when there are none.

ConfigModelDetail.description: Full stored config for a model plus llama-server flags parsed out of its command. ctx_size and n_gpu_layers are the raw flag values (strings); offload fields reflect the current command.

flags.description: All --flags parsed from the command, as raw string values.

metadata.description: Optional capability metadata for this model. llama-skein extension for MTP and other runtime capabilities.

effective_flags.description: Read-only: the launch command after GPU-tuning profile injection. The stored `cmd` is unchanged; compare the two to see what the profile added.

errors.description: Present on a 422 response: why the config was rejected. Absent on success.

warnings.description: Risky-but-loadable settings detected in the config that was (or would be) applied.

model.description: Model ID or alias to use when a request omits the 'model' field.
Configured default model ID, or null when no default is set.

MtpMetadata.description: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) capability for llama.cpp models. Enables running supported GGUF models with draft model guidance for multi-token prediction.

enabled.description: Whether MTP is enabled for this model. When true, the model command must include --spec-type draft-mtp and a draft model.

spec_type.description: The spec type for draft models. For MTP-enabled models, this is always 'draft-mtp'.

draft_n_max.description: Maximum draft N value (number of prompt tokens per generated token). Recommended starting point is 2 for most models.

draft_n_tunable.description: Optional list of tunable draft N values that were benchmarked on this model. If present, llama-skein will try values from this list when auto-tuning MTP.

model_draft.description: Optional explicit path to the draft model GGUF file. If omitted, llama-skein will automatically download the draft model from Hugging Face when MTP is enabled.

memory_overhead_mb.description: Approximate additional memory overhead in MB when running this model with MTP enabled. Use this for capacity-aware scheduling.

source.description: How this metadata was derived: 'config' for explicitly set metadata, 'cmd' for parsed values from the llama-server command string.

applicable.description: False for non-MoE models and backends where offload does not apply (e.g. mlx); see reason.

n_cpu_moe.description: Recommended --n-cpu-moe value (number of leading layers whose MoE experts to offload to CPU). 0 means the model fits fully on GPU.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the recommendation or why it is not applicable.

expert_bytes_total.description: Estimated total bytes of MoE expert tensors in the model.

vram_free_mb.description: Free VRAM (MB) used for the calculation; falls back to system RAM when no GPU is present.

fits_fully_on_gpu.description: True when the model fits in free VRAM without any offload.

ctx_size.description: Context length assumed for the KV-cache portion of the estimate.

name.description: Variant label, e.g. "Q4_K_M" or "8bit". Echoed back in the verdict and used as the recommended-variant reference.

file_bytes.description: Resident weight size of this variant: the GGUF file size, or the summed safetensors sizes for MLX.

HypotheticalDims.description: Explicit model dimensions, when the catalog knows them (e.g. from the model's config.json). Any zero/absent field falls back to estimation from params_b.

head_dim.description: Explicit K/V head dimension; derived from embedding_length/head_count when absent.

model.description: Free-form label for the candidate (e.g. the HF repo id). Echoed back; not resolved against configured models.

backend.description: Backend the model would run under. Defaults to llamacpp. MLX scores against the unified-memory budget with f16 KV.

params_b.description: Parameter count in billions; the estimation source when dims are absent. MoE models should pass explicit dims — the dense estimation table does not model them.

arch_family.description: Architecture family hint (e.g. "qwen3", "llama"). Recorded for the caller; not yet used in estimation.

requested_ctx.description: Score at this context size, like /api/fit/{model}?ctx=. 0/absent scores at the trained context capped by what VRAM allows.

cache_type_k.description: llama.cpp --cache-type-k the model would run with (f16 default).

cache_type_v.description: llama.cpp --cache-type-v the model would run with (f16 default).

fit_level.description: Same vocabulary as ModelFit.fit_level. A hypothetical model earns an honest "no" — the deployed-model rescue to "marginal" does not apply.

max_safe_ctx.description: Prompt budget at the scored context; 0 when the variant does not fit.

max_fit_ctx.description: Largest context that fits VRAM for this variant, capped at the trained context.

estimated.description: True when any core dimension was estimated from params_b rather than supplied explicitly — verdicts are best-effort, not GGUF-derived.

recommended.description: Name of the largest variant whose fit_level is perfect or good, else the largest tight one. Absent when nothing fits.

FitLevel.description: How well a model fits a host. "unknown" means host VRAM could not be read yet (not that the model does not fit); max_safe_ctx is 0 in that case. Shared by ModelFit (an installed model) and HypotheticalVariantFit (a gallery candidate not yet on disk) so both report identically.

FitScore.description: Per-dimension fit scores in [0,1], weighted by use-case (ported from llmfit fit.rs ScoreComponents).

speed.description: Speed score from estimated tokens/sec on this host.

fit.description: Memory-headroom score: how comfortably the model fits.

context.description: Context-capacity score: usable context vs the model's trained max.

ModelFit.description: Fit of one model to THIS host: whether it runs, how well, and the max SAFE context (output- and overhead-reserved). Ported from llmfit fit.rs ModelFit.

fit_level.description: How well the model fits this host. "unknown" means host VRAM could not be read yet (not that the model does not fit); max_safe_ctx is 0 in that case.

under_configured.description: True when a configured model's --ctx-size is materially below the context VRAM could safely hold. Signals a starved config that the fit report would otherwise hide behind the small configured_ctx.

max_fit_ctx.description: Largest --ctx-size (hard n_ctx) that fits this host's VRAM. The grow target for an under-configured model. 0 when VRAM is unknown.

run_mode.description: How the model would run given memory.

configured_ctx.description: Current --ctx-size in the model command (the KV allocation / hard n_ctx).

max_safe_ctx.description: Max context callers should fill: reserves the output budget plus compute/overhead so prompt+generation never exceed the backend's hard n_ctx, and accounts for llama-server dividing n_ctx across --parallel slots (per-request share). THIS is the number opencode/skein should trim to, not configured_ctx.

kv_mb_at_max_safe_ctx.description: KV-cache size (MB) at max_safe_ctx, given the host's cache-type quantization.

vram_required_mb.description: Estimated VRAM needed: weights + KV + compute buffers (MB).

est_tokens_per_sec.description: Estimated generation throughput on this host (benchmark-derived).

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the fit verdict.

FitReport.description: Fit of every configured model to this host. Aggregated by skein across providers for fleet placement.

TuningFlags.description: Additive, safe-to-inject llama-server flags. Omitted fields are not set.

TuningMTP.description: MTP speculative-decoding flags, applied only to MTP-capable models.

TuningProfile.description: One (gfx, use-case) entry in the tuning database: recommended defaults + provenance notes.

verified.description: True only if measured in-repo on this arch.

TuningStatus.description: Effective GPU tuning for this host: detected arch, whether enabled, the resolved profile after user overrides, and per-value provenance. Profiles are recommendations the operator can override or disable.

detected_gfx.description: Empty when no known AMD GPU is detected.

enabled.description: False disables all auto-injection; the model cmd launches verbatim.

provenance.description: Per-field origin: 'recommended' (from the profile) or 'override' (set by the user).

backend_env.description: Effective glibc allocator env vars injected into each llama.cpp backend process on this host (e.g. MALLOC_MMAP_THRESHOLD_). Empty/absent on non-Linux hosts or when disabled. Recommended defaults, overridable per-model or via backend_env=false.

TuningPatchRequest.description: Partial per-host tuning override. A set field forces that value (including disabling a recommendation); a null field resets it to the built-in recommendation. Profiles are never forced.

mtp.description: Force MTP on/off regardless of the profile.

extra_args.description: Arbitrary extra flags the curated profile does not model.

backend_env.description: Toggle glibc allocator-env injection (MALLOC_* caps) on Linux llama.cpp backends. false disables it while leaving GPU flag tuning active; true or null defers to the built-in default (enabled on Linux).

LastError.description: The most recent start or load failure, retained after the process is gone so callers can distinguish a broken model from an idle one. Kept as history across a later successful start; 'state' is what reports the current condition.

category.description: 'start' = never reached a serving state; 'crash' = was ready then exited on its own.

attempts.description: Consecutive failures; reset on a successful start.

ModelHealth.description: Per-model readiness. 'failed' is distinct from 'stopped': stopped means idle with nothing wrong, failed means the last load attempt failed.

warnings.description: Risky-but-loadable settings detected for this model (e.g. flash-attn on a GPU known to wedge with it). Informational only.

HealthResponse.description: What the host can actually serve right now. Lets a caller preflight — distinguishing ready, loading, busy, failed and idle-with-no-model-resident — instead of discovering it by spending an inference request.

any_model_resident.description: True when at least one model is loaded and serving. False here with a reachable control plane is the 'up but not serving' case.

busy.description: True when at least one inference request is in flight. A single-slot host that is busy will queue a new request.

watchdog.description: GPU-stall watchdog status. Present even when inactive — reason explains why.

WatchdogStatus.description: GPU-stall watchdog observability. Active means the watchdog is monitoring for wedged backends.

active.description: True when the watchdog is actively monitoring GPU stall signatures.

reason.description: Human-readable reason when inactive (e.g., 'disabled by config', 'no perf monitor', 'GPU does not report memory-activity telemetry'). Omitted when active.

silent_mode.description: Whether GPU power limits are applied.

power.description: Thermal profile applied when silent_mode is true.

schedule.description: Optional time window in HH:MM-HH:MM format for automatic silent mode toggling. Empty means always follow silent_mode setting.

power_limit_pct.description: Percentage of default TDP to cap at (1-99).

temp_target_celsius.description: GPU temperature target while in silent mode (40-100).

available.description: Whether GPU power control is available on this host.

active.description: Whether silent mode is currently active.

ConfigWarning.description: A risky-but-loadable piece of configuration, surfaced for awareness. Never causes a config or model to be rejected — see ConfigStatus for what IS rejected (parse/validation failures).

model.description: Model ID this warning concerns, absent for a config-wide warning.

flag.description: The specific flag/setting the warning is about, if applicable.

source.description: Stable identifier for what produced the warning, e.g. "flash-attn-gfx", so a client can key on it instead of parsing message text.

ConfigStatus.description: Whether the on-disk config is currently valid. A previous invalid edit or reload never breaks serving — the last valid config keeps running — but must be visible here until fixed.

error.description: Present when valid is false: the parse/validation error from the most recent failed reload attempt.

stale_since.description: When the config first went invalid. Absent when valid.

ConfigValidateRequest.description: Optional dry-run body. Omit to validate the on-disk config file as-is.

config.description: Raw YAML to validate instead of reading the on-disk file. Never written anywhere — this is a pure dry run.

id.description: Snapshot identifier — pass as ref to POST /api/config/rollback.

actor.description: What produced this snapshot: "reload" (file edit/SIGHUP/API write), "rollback", "legacy-bak" (migrated from an old config.yaml.bak* file), or an API-specific tag.

Backend.description: Inference backend type. Controls backend-specific behaviours (e.g. slot cancellation is llamacpp-only). mlx targets Apple Silicon; vllm targets NVIDIA (CUDA); AMD ROCm requires building vllm from source. Default: llamacpp. Extracted as a shared schema (like FitLevel — see the fit-hypothetical-models change) because RuntimeInfo, RuntimeHealth, Model, ConfigModelRequest, ConfigModelPatchRequest, OffloadRecommendation, ModelFit, and ModelRegistration all share this exact value set; leaving it duplicated inline let oapi-codegen's collision-avoidance dedup rename generated constants unpredictably whenever a new inline occurrence was added.

ArtifactRole.description: What an install artifact is for. "projector" is a multimodal vision/audio projection file (llama.cpp mmproj); "other" covers auxiliary files (e.g. a chat template) that are not weights, a projector, a tokenizer, or config.

path.description: Repository-relative source path, e.g. "model-Q4_K_M-00001-of-00002.gguf". Never a full URL or a path outside the pinned repository/revision — resolved against source_repository/source_revision at plan-validation time.

size_bytes.description: Expected size in bytes. Used for disk preflight and to detect a truncated or corrupt download; not itself a trust signal.

digest.description: Optional "sha256:<hex>" content digest. Verified after download when present; a missing digest is reported as weaker verification, not rejected outright (see design.md decision 4).

model_id.description: The config/model ID to register once every required artifact is installed. Must be a valid, not-already-configured ID; the plan is rejected before any download starts otherwise.

backend.description: Inference backend the registered model will run under. Matches ConfigModelRequest.backend's vocabulary — installation registers through the same config path load/unload already use, not a separate mechanism.

flags.description: Raw backend command-line flags to apply at registration, e.g. "--n-gpu-layers", "999". A minimal passthrough for the first slice; ConfigModelRequest's typed fields (n_cpu_moe, cpu_moe, cpu_offload_gb, override_tensor) remain the richer path for anything that needs validation beyond "is this a string".

ttl.description: Idle-unload TTL in seconds, same semantics as ConfigModelRequest.ttl.

ModelInstallPlan.description: An immutable installation plan (design.md decision 2). The server validates and snapshots this into a ModelOperation with a host-generated ID; the plan itself is never mutated after submission.

source_repository.description: e.g. "unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF". A display name or mutable branch reference is not artifact identity — see source_revision.

source_revision.description: Immutable revision (commit SHA), not a mutable branch name. Required so a plan identifies exact, reproducible source content.

token.description: Hugging Face access token for a gated repository. A request secret, not artifact identity: never persisted in the operation record, logged, or echoed back in an error (design.md decision 7). Not yet used to authenticate a download — no download execution exists yet (sections 3-4) — accepted now so the redaction guarantee is in place before there is anything to redact from.

ModelOperationPhase.description: Host-local operation state machine (design.md decision 3). "succeeded", "cancelled", and "failed" are the only terminal phases; every other phase can still transition to "cancelled" or "failed".

bytes_total.description: Omitted when the artifact's expected size could not be confirmed (weaker verification path); present whenever the plan's InstallArtifact.size_bytes was trusted.

ModelOperationError.description: Typed terminal error for a failed operation. "code" is a stable identifier automation can branch on; "message" is the human-readable detail (never includes an auth token — see design.md decision 7).

code.description: "range_unsupported" means the origin could not honor a resume request and a full restart was required, not that the operation failed outright — it only becomes a terminal error if the restart itself then fails.

ModelOperation.description: Server-assigned record for one installation. GET returns a snapshot; an event stream (added in a later task) supplies incremental updates using this same vocabulary.

id.description: Host-generated operation ID, assigned when the plan is accepted. Stable across client disconnect/reconnect.

model_id.description: Present once registration succeeds; absent before then.

bytes_total.description: Aggregate across all artifacts; omitted if any artifact's total is unknown.

warnings.description: Non-terminal warnings, e.g. a digest that could not be verified but size matched.
